summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Rokadly daily cash and payment reconciliation web app. Backend API tests: 34/34 passed (100%). Frontend UI tests: All major flows working correctly with demo account buttons, multi-role dashboards, bill entry with drafts, reconciliation with pending items, manager readiness checklist, admin pages, and mobile responsiveness.
